act.long_title: An Act to define and amend the law relating to Promissory Notes, Bills of Exchange and Cheques.

licence: Published with commentary and other original matter under s.52(1)(q)(ii), Copyright Act 1957.

section.heading: Presentment of cheque to charge any other person
section.html: A cheque must, in order to charge any person except the drawer, be presented within a reasonable time after delivery thereof by such person.
section.text: A cheque must, in order to charge any person except the drawer, be presented within a reasonable time after delivery thereof by such person.
